evals.prompt: 这个仓库已经有客户管理页。请新增供应商管理页，功能包括关键词/状态筛选、分页、新增、编辑、禁用、删除和权限控制。不要重新设计整套前端，要与现有产品一致并直接实现。
evals.expected_output: Inspects the repository, selects the existing customer-management flow as the closest analogue, adapts a complete vertical slice (route/menu/access/page/service/query key/types/tests), preserves the target theme/request/state/modal conventions, and verifies the real workflow.
expectations: Inspects target-local authority before choosing a design
Uses the closest proven implementation by job and interaction rather than inventing a generic page
Covers the full vertical slice, not only the visible page component
Preserves target architecture and styling conventions
Runs repository-defined checks and verifies critical browser interactions when available

evals.prompt: 把一个成熟后台项目作为参考，把当前半成品前端补成可用系统。当前项目已有后端 API 和品牌，不允许照搬参考项目的业务、角色和文案。请实施迁移。
evals.expected_output: Performs an adoption workflow: inventories target and reference, classifies capabilities as reuse/adapt/replace/bridge/omit/remove, preserves target API and brand, migrates foundations in dependency order, lands representative vertical slices, checks source residue, and verifies build and browser flows.
expectations: Creates an evidence-based target/reference capability matrix
Preserves target APIs, brand, and owned integration seams
Migrates foundations in dependency order instead of blindly copying a tree
Removes reference-specific routes, roles, names, assets, and dead dependencies
Verifies a representative end-to-end path before considering the migration complete

evals.prompt: 现有地图工作台在窄屏下地图被挤没了，右侧参数面板出现双滚动。请参考仓库里另一个正常的地图工作区修好，不要强行改成普通卡片列表。
evals.expected_output: Selects the working map workspace as the analogue, traces its viewport allocation and resize behavior, repairs shrink/overflow ownership without imposing a generic card grid, preserves target map infrastructure, and verifies geometry and interactions at relevant viewports.
expectations: Chooses the map-workspace analogue rather than a visually generic page
Keeps the map/canvas as the primary surface
Repairs the complete size and shrink chain and assigns one intentional vertical scroll owner
Preserves the existing map engine and target styling system
Uses browser geometry and interaction evidence at desktop and narrow viewports

evals.prompt: 给这个已有设计系统的 Ant Design 项目加一个审批列表。项目卡片圆角是 16px、页面间距 24px、没有页面标题，并使用自己的 CSS Modules 和请求封装。请按项目现状实现。
evals.expected_output: Respects the target project's established 16px radius, 24px spacing, headerless page pattern, CSS Modules, and request wrapper; uses Ant Design facts only for version-sensitive APIs; does not inject fallback tokens or universal copy/layout rules.
expectations: Treats target theme and layout conventions as authoritative
Does not overwrite project choices with bundled fallback dimensions or page-title rules
Reuses the target request wrapper and CSS Modules strategy
Implements approval-specific permissions, states, mutations, feedback, and confirmation
Queries Ant Design documentation only where version-sensitive evidence is needed

evals.prompt: 把列表筛选区的“清空”按钮改成“重置筛选”，并同步它的无障碍名称。重置行为保持不变。
evals.expected_output: Inspects the affected control, locale/accessibility bindings and relevant tests; makes a local change preserving reset behavior. Does not audit unrelated services/auth or create a new vertical slice, migration matrix, or design system. Runs relevant and repository-required checks without duplicating equivalent evidence.
expectations: Uses the smallest affected component and test boundary, not a whole-repository inventory
Updates visible and accessible names consistently while preserving reset behavior
Does not add unrelated service, permission, routing or architecture changes
Avoids mandatory analogue searches, API lookups and process reports that cannot affect this change
Verifies the changed labels and unchanged behavior with relevant evidence and required repository checks

evals.prompt: 新增通知偏好设置页。项目已有设置路由、表单组件、权限封装、请求层和真实的偏好读写 API，但没有相似的业务页面，也没有提供外部参考仓库。请直接实现。
evals.expected_output: Uses established primitives and actual preference contracts to build the smallest complete settings journey without requiring a missing analogue. Connects route/access/data/form/mutation feedback and tests, preserves target integrations, and verifies loading/error/retry/save behavior.
expectations: Recognizes that no complete analogue exists and proceeds from target-owned primitives and contracts
Does not stall for an external example or invent a backend API
Implements the needed route, permission, data and form integration
Covers loading, error/retry, validation, pending, save feedback and state refresh
Verifies the complete changed journey without replacing unrelated infrastructure
